# BOSS 1 – Electro Mechanical

> Licensed mobile mechanic and auto electrician (NSW Motor Vehicle Repairer Licence MVRL 60872) based in Merrylands, New South Wales, Australia (postcode 2160). Mobile service across 20 Western Sydney suburbs, Monday to Saturday 8am–8pm (closed Sunday). Phone 0413 404 040.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://boss1electromechanic-au.com/): Overview, booking and contact.
- [Services](https://boss1electromechanic-au.com/services): Electrical and mechanical services.
- [Service areas](https://boss1electromechanic-au.com/service-areas): The 20 suburbs covered.
- [Contact](https://boss1electromechanic-au.com/contact): Call, WhatsApp or send a booking request.

## Services
- [Car batteries](https://boss1electromechanic-au.com/car-battery-service-western-sydney): Testing, jump starts and replacement.
- [Brakes](https://boss1electromechanic-au.com/brake-service-western-sydney): Brake checks, pads and discs.
- [Scanning & diagnostics](https://boss1electromechanic-au.com/engine-diagnostics-western-sydney): Warning lights, electrical testing, programming.
- [Roadside breakdowns](https://boss1electromechanic-au.com/roadside-assistance-western-sydney): Flat batteries, no-starts, flat tyres.
- Also: alternators, starters, air conditioning, hybrid systems, engine repairs, servicing and oil changes, tyre changes.

Merrylands, Parramatta, Granville, Guildford, Fairfield, Blacktown, Auburn, Wentworthville, Westmead, Greystanes, Liverpool, Bankstown, Penrith, Castle Hill, Ryde, Baulkham Hills, Seven Hills, Cabramatta, Lidcombe, Mount Druitt.
